provenance.notes: A Jitsi Meet instance other than meet.jit.si and 8x8's JaaS (8x8.vc), which have policies of their own (policy-meet-jit-si.json, policy-jaas.json; the gateway picks one by its domain). Its terms are its operator's, unknown to this package: an instance of one's own has none but the site's, a public one (a community's, a university's) has its own. Jitsi Meet itself is Apache-2.0 software; nothing here limits what the instance carries. The site declares what it knows through its tightening.
